blockBehavior.label: Block Behavior
blockBehavior.description: The block’s behaviors and their keys (sounds, growth, storage …)

blockStatesArgumentsSlabBaseBlock.label: Vanilla slab
blockStatesArgumentsSlabBaseBlock.description: The vanilla slab whose unused states the slab borrows (its look is replaced).
blockStatesArgumentsSlabBaseBlock.hint: Each vanilla block can carry only one custom block. CraftEngine’s own default pack uses petrified_oak_slab.

blockStatesArgumentsStairsBaseBlock.label: Vanilla stairs
blockStatesArgumentsStairsBaseBlock.description: The vanilla stairs whose unused states the stairs borrow.
blockStatesArgumentsStairsBaseBlock.hint: Each vanilla block can carry only one custom block. CraftEngine’s own default pack uses cut_copper_stairs.

blockStatesArgumentsDoorBaseBlock.label: Vanilla door
blockStatesArgumentsDoorBaseBlock.description: The vanilla door whose powered states the door borrows (they look the same as the unpowered ones).
blockStatesArgumentsDoorBaseBlock.hint: Each vanilla block can carry only one custom block. CraftEngine’s own default pack uses oak_door.

blockStatesArgumentsTrapdoorBaseBlock.label: Vanilla trapdoor
blockStatesArgumentsTrapdoorBaseBlock.description: The vanilla trapdoor whose powered states the trapdoor borrows.
blockStatesArgumentsTrapdoorBaseBlock.hint: Each vanilla block can carry only one custom block. CraftEngine’s own default pack uses oak_trapdoor.

blockStatesArgumentsFenceGateBaseBlock.label: Vanilla fence gate
blockStatesArgumentsFenceGateBaseBlock.description: The vanilla fence gate whose powered states the fence gate borrows.
blockStatesArgumentsFenceGateBaseBlock.hint: Each vanilla block can carry only one custom block. CraftEngine’s own default pack uses oak_fence_gate.

blockStatesArgumentsFenceBaseBlock.label: Vanilla fence
blockStatesArgumentsFenceBaseBlock.description: The vanilla fence whose collision the fence uses. Its look comes from the post and side items.
blockStatesArgumentsFenceBaseBlock.hint: Several fences may share one vanilla fence.

blockStatesArgumentsFencePostItem.label: Post item
blockStatesArgumentsFencePostItem.description: The item whose model CraftEngine shows as the fence post.
blockStatesArgumentsFencePostItem.hint: Create two items for the post and the side, each with its model (for example with the parents block/fence_post and block/fence_side).

blockStatesArgumentsFenceSideItem.label: Side item
blockStatesArgumentsFenceSideItem.description: The item whose model CraftEngine shows for each connected side.

blockStatesArgumentsButtonBaseBlock.label: Vanilla button
blockStatesArgumentsButtonBaseBlock.description: The vanilla button whose states (and collision) the button uses. Its look comes from the pressed and not pressed items.
blockStatesArgumentsButtonBaseBlock.hint: Several buttons may share one vanilla button.

blockStatesArgumentsButtonNotPressedItem.label: Not pressed item
blockStatesArgumentsButtonNotPressedItem.description: The item whose model CraftEngine shows while the button is not pressed.
blockStatesArgumentsButtonNotPressedItem.hint: Create two items for the button, each with its model (for example with the parents block/button and block/button_pressed).

blockStatesArgumentsButtonPressedItem.label: Pressed item
blockStatesArgumentsButtonPressedItem.description: The item whose model CraftEngine shows while the button is pressed.

blockStatesArgumentsLeavesTintable.label: Biome tint
blockStatesArgumentsLeavesTintable.description: The leaves take the biome’s foliage color (the texture should be gray).

blockStatesArgumentsLeavesMaxDistance.label: Max distance
blockStatesArgumentsLeavesMaxDistance.description: How far the leaves may be from a log before they decay (vanilla 7).

blockBehavior.label: Behavior
blockBehavior.description: The block’s main behavior with its keys. The behavior select of the Block section sets it up.

blockBehaviors.label: More behaviors
blockBehaviors.description: Further behaviors, each with its keys. The export writes them before the main behavior.
blockBehaviors.hint: Combine behaviors like the jar does, e.g. falling_block with concrete_powder_block, or bush_block to choose what a plant stands on. Each behavior needs the block state properties its wiki page lists.
